name: Exile Gear Raynar
source:
A young woman named Kuni's dream of becoming a robot pilot comes true when she's invited to the base home to the world's most powerful robot, Raynar.

[From [url=http://games.renpy.org/game/raynar.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
名叫库妮的年轻女子受邀前往一座基地。那里停放着世界上最强大的机器人“雷纳尔”，她成为机器人驾驶员的梦想也终于实现。

[引自[url=http://games.renpy.org/game/raynar.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
